notes: «عن عمه محمد بن أبي القاسم» is one link, the name alone (rule 7); «- رحمه الله -» is a blessing, left out
«بإسناده رفعه إلى» marks a gap between النهيكي and the Imam: an unnamed link in its place (rule 8)
The Imam is named inside the chain after «إلى», so he stays a narrator, not imam_in_text
